DOTA_Crownfall_EncounterDesc_Match3: The Eldwurm Order's test of strategy and skill.
DOTA_Match3_HowToPlay:
MAKE MATCHES
Drag a gem to swap it with its neighbor. Make matches of THREE of the same color gems to clear those gems. Make matches of FOUR gems in a row to create special ability gems. Matches of FIVE OR MORE gems will create even more powerful ability gems.

ACTIVATE ABILITIES
Match ability gems with other gems of the same color in order to trigger their abilities.

ENEMY ATTACKS
Enemies attack you and use their own special abilities on a timer. The game is over if you ever lose all of your health.

DEFEAT YOUR ENEMIES
Every gem matched does ONE POINT OF DAMAGE to your opponent. Special abilities do extra damage. Defeat all of the enemies in order to beat the game.
